title: Home Exterior Upgrade Ideas | Stone Transformation Before & After
description: Looking for home exterior upgrade ideas? See how adding stone transformed this home’s curb appeal without a full remodel. Real before and after.
text:
Looking for Home Exterior Upgrade Ideas That Actually Make a Difference?
See how adding stone transformed this home’s exterior—creating contrast, texture, and a more finished look without major construction.

Avery Housley

Project Coordinator

Hi, I’m Avery, and I worked with this homeowner on a simple exterior upgrade focused on improving curb appeal.

The home was in good condition, but like many houses with siding, it felt a bit flat and lacked visual contrast. From the street, it didn’t stand out and it didn’t have the finished look the homeowner wanted.

They weren’t looking for a full remodel. They just wanted a way to upgrade the exterior and make the home feel more complete.

See What Your Home Could Look Like

A Complete Exterior Upgrade Without a Full Remodel
Updating Vinyl Siding • Remove Vinyl and Install the Stone

Sometimes the right upgrade isn’t about changing everything—it’s about improving the areas that make the biggest visual impact. By adding stone along the lower portion of the exterior, this project created contrast, texture, and a more finished look while keeping the existing siding intact.

✅ Remove the vinyl siding and install

✅ No substrate clean up required

✅ Completed in days, not weeks

A Simple Upgrade That Completely Changed the Look of the Home
A simple upgrade turned this builder-grade exterior into a clean, custom look adding depth, contrast, and a high-end finish without major construction.

Before

The Goal

- Exterior felt flat and lacked contrast

- Needed more visual interest

- Wanted a more finished, high-end look

- Keep most existing siding

- Avoid a full remodel

After

The Solution

- Add stone along the lower façade

- Create contrast with existing siding

- Introduce natural texture

- Improve curb appeal with minimal changes

- Achieve a more complete, intentional look

What Does a Project Like This Cost?

Most homeowners are surprised how affordable upgrades like this can be. Projects like this typically range between $3,000–$7,500, depending on the size of the area and layout. Many homeowners choose to expand projects like this over time.

Try Visualizer Get Your Project Estimate

Project Details

- Products Used: Panels, Corners

- Color: Northern Slate

- Install: Remove Vinyl and Install

Will This Work on Homes Like Mine?

Yes, GenStone can be installed over any flat surface.

Why Not Just Replace the Siding?

Removing the existing siding can add thousands to a project like this, GenStone can be added as a contrast, elevating all the siding.

Northern Slate Color Guide

This color was chosen to create contrast against the lighter siding while maintaining a natural stone look that works across a wide range of home styles.
